name: Tsukuyomi Masaru
source:
The main character of this work. A second year student attending a private university in Tokyo.
He excels in school and is relatively good at sports.
He is handsome with beautiful eyebrows, but atypically for a young man these days, he doesn't speak much and is a bit unfriendly.
Her quiet and calm demeanor appears mysterious to the opposite sex, and although he is quite popular, she doesn't like casual relationships, so he doesn't have a specific girlfriend at the moment.
Since he grew up in a single-parent household with his mother as his only parent, he wants to become independent as soon as possible and support her life.
Although he is aware of he might seem to be something of a "mama's boy", he has a desire for his mother who is forever young and beautiful, a love which goes beyond the familial. He feels that he is abnormal and experiences angst over these feelings.

(Adapted from EroGameScape character description, https://erogamescape.dyndns.org/~ap2/ero/toukei_kaiseki/character.php?character=10476
